project.title: NASA Psyche Mission: AR/WebXR for Public Engagement—CERNN: Satellite Experience

section-description.title: Project Overview
section-description.description: This project envisions an accessible, interactive AR experience that translates complex NASA data into an engaging narrative, allowing users of all ages to explore the Psyche spacecraft and track its journey in real time.

item.detail: Users interact with a glowing 3D model, discovering how onboard instruments support the mission's goal of mapping and analyzing Psyche 16.
A scrubbable, real-time tracking system highlights critical milestones from launch to orbit, building anticipation through countdowns and progress markers.
Intuitive mobile gestures ensure audiences of all technical and physical abilities can seamlessly engage with the scientific content.

section-description.title: Core Functional Requirements
section-description.description: Requirements elicit from sponsor for the Psyche mission education project

item.detail: Web-based AR/VR launches instantly via QR code from the Psyche Launchpad without requiring app downloads or personal data.
Bite-sized, single-user educational modules designed for the public, featuring on-demand contextual gesture instructions.
Features a real-time countdown to arrival and an explorable 3D spacecraft model tracking the journey to Psyche 16.
Interactive 3D inspection that uses visual cues (pulsing highlights) to guide users through discovering and learning about onboard instruments.
Navigable milestone tracker allowing users to explore critical mission events, from launch through future instrument deployments.

section-description.title: Sprint Objectives & Execution
section-description.description: Spearheaded early-stage product discovery by synthesizing NASA scientific research, evaluating Augmented Reality (AR) technology stacks, and engineering comprehensive UX prototypes to define requirements for three distinct interactive experiences.

item.detail: Evaluated multiple Augmented Reality (AR) APIs, frontend frameworks, and rendering libraries, documenting comprehensive cost-benefit analyses to dictate the project's core technology stack.
Architected high-level system workflows by developing detailed Use Case diagrams for the "Satellite," "Lore," and "Detective" modules to establish clear user interaction pathways.
Synthesized complex scientific data by analyzing extensive NASA research publications, distilling the findings into concise information sheets to ensure narrative and technical accuracy.
Authored foundational Design Documents and formal Experience Requirements across all planned applications to align stakeholder vision with concrete development milestones.
Designed high-fidelity wireframes and accessible UI mockups for central landing pages and immersive AR interfaces, focusing on user engagement and intuitive navigation.
Modeled preliminary 3D assets of the Psyche asteroid to integrate directly into early visual prototypes and formal stakeholder design presentations.

section-description.title: Sprint Objectives & Execution
section-description.description: Engineered an interactive 3D frontend architecture and foundational WebAR prototypes, prioritizing inclusive design through comprehensive accessibility settings, mobile-responsive controls, and robust user onboarding.

item.detail: Engineered an immersive 3D homepage featuring a dynamically lit skybox and a polygon-optimized Psyche satellite model to ensure high graphical fidelity alongside rapid browser load times.
Implemented mobile-responsive camera mechanics, enabling seamless swipe-to-rotate and pinch-to-zoom gesture controls for intuitive environmental exploration across all devices.
Designed and developed a globally accessible configuration matrix, integrating critical visual accessibility modes including dynamic dark/light themes, high-contrast, and color-blind settings.
Programmed intelligent user onboarding mechanics, constructing a comprehensive help interface that automatically triggers after extended periods of user inactivity to explain interaction gestures.

Architected the core frontend application flow by linking the primary launch, settings, and main engagement pages, enhancing the user journey with scroll-triggered fade animations and polished loading screens.

Spearheaded early-stage Augmented Reality (AR) research by constructing foundational WebAR prototypes using AR.js and drafting comprehensive activity diagrams to dictate complex application state flows.

stage.title: Data Integration, Interactive Systems & Audio Implementation

section-description.title: Sprint Objectives & Execution
section-description.description: Engineered real-time data pipelines for telemetry tracking, implemented modular interactive user interfaces, and integrated comprehensive audio and accessibility systems to enhance the mission exploration experience.

item.detail: Developed a robust data pipeline to parse the NASA Horizons API, translating complex ephemeris telemetry into a structured XML database for optimized client-side mission tracking.
Engineered dynamic frontend rendering mechanics to visualize real-time spacecraft distance and trajectory data directly from the newly generated XML datasets.

Designed and implemented an interactive instrument discovery system, utilizing a decoupled JSON data structure to dynamically populate detailed informational modals for all five core satellite instruments.

Constructed a visual mission timeline interface featuring custom graphics and localized scientific research, supported by refactored, modularized JavaScript architectures to ensure codebase scalability.
Integrated a responsive audio ecosystem featuring immersive ambient soundscapes and low-latency interactive sound effects (SFX) triggered across critical application state transitions.

Programmed persistent state management utilizing local storage to retain user preferences across sessions, explicitly supporting volume controls and newly implemented accessibility settings like colorblind mode.

stage.title: Accessibility Integration, Data Visualization & Mobile Polish

section-description.title: Sprint Objectives & Execution
section-description.description: Engineered global accessibility themes, optimized mobile responsiveness, and refined dynamic data visualizations to deliver a polished, inclusive, and rigorously user-tested interactive experience.

item.detail: Implemented comprehensive visual accessibility configurations, successfully propagating high-contrast, color-blind, and light-mode themes across all global UI components and modals.
Refined core user interface mechanics by programming automated onboarding tutorials, intuitive click-away modal dismissal logic, and cohesive 3D skybox environments.
Engineered dynamic telemetry UI components to accurately render real-time mission metrics, effectively splitting and displaying distance-traveled and time-to-arrival data on the main interface.
Developed enriched narrative modules featuring integrated launch videos, contextual phase imagery, and a seamlessly integrated About page housing team biographies and project citations.

Optimized application responsiveness for mobile and tablet devices by overhauling navigation layouts, implementing swipe gestures for instrument popups, and rectifying viewport-specific timer rendering bugs.
Executed formal beta testing protocols and user feedback loops to drive iterative product improvements, resulting in upgraded 3D satellite models and refined, user-friendly ambient audio profiles.

section-description.title: Educational UX Design & Data Architecture
section-description.description: To ensure the experience was highly educational and intuitive for users of all ages and cognitive abilities, I overhauled the content strategy, integrated multimedia elements, and optimized the backend data delivery.

item.detail: Restructured complex technical data for the Mission and Instruments sections into an accessible "What, Why, and How" framework to maximize user comprehension across diverse age groups.
Enriched the educational phases with contextual images and videos, supporting visual learners and increasing overall user retention and engagement.
Re-engineered content delivery by transitioning hardcoded phase data into a structured JSON architecture, improving system scalability and maintaining consistency across the application.
Refined user flows and interface components to guarantee a polished, highly accessible, and confident user experience for all audiences.
